items.headline: Bryson’s LIV Struggles
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau endured a nightmare opening round at LIV Golf New York on Thursday, facing multiple problems during his play.

items.headline: Spieth’s Rough Tee Off
items.text: Jordan Spieth started the Wyndham Championship with an iron shot out of bounds on the first tee, risking his positioning in the PGA Tour’s regular-season finale.
